language: JavaScript (Node.js 24) rule checks over Dockerfile, .dockerignore, compose.yaml and .gitignore files

failingTests: backend Dockerfile has a named JDK build stage and a JRE runtime stage
backend Dockerfile copies pom.xml and downloads dependencies before copying src
backend runtime stage copies only the jar from the build stage
backend runtime stage starts the jar with ENTRYPOINT or CMD
compose.yaml defines the api service built from ./backend and a postgres:18 db service
compose.yaml keeps database data in a declared named volume
compose.yaml binds every published port to 127.0.0.1
compose.yaml takes the database password from ${VAR} or an env_file, never a literal
the local env file is ignored by Git and not tracked
api datasource URL uses the db service name, not localhost
db has a pg_isready healthcheck and api waits for service_healthy
backend .dockerignore leaves out build output, version control and secrets
frontend .dockerignore leaves out installed packages, build output, version control and secrets
frontend Dockerfile builds with Node and serves with nginx
frontend Dockerfile installs dependencies before copying the source
frontend nginx stage copies only dist from the build stage

cleanup.notes: Delete tests/node_modules (created by npm ci) and starter/.env (your disposable local password file). The lab creates no database, image, container or volume: nothing runs a container engine.
